provenance: Generated by scripts/record-handoff.mjs using the local evidence compiler and output guard. Synthetic release claims; real compiler and guard results. No model was called, no brief was written, and no release was published.
scope: The guard validates compilation freshness for an output path when the host invokes it. It does not verify the truth of claims or enforce a release gate on its own.

stages.title: The handoff is checked
stages.explanation: The compiler records which evidence it checked. The output guard allows the brief because that evidence still matches.

stages.title: The evidence changes
stages.explanation: A later check fails. The file timestamp is preserved, reproducing the old bug. The new guard checks the content and blocks the stale handoff.
stages.claim: The migration regression check failed after the latest change.

decision.reason: BLOCKED: Compilation is stale or uncertified. Run grainulator compile.

stages.title: The brief can reflect the failure
stages.explanation: Recompiling binds the brief to the changed evidence. This permits writing an accurate brief; it does not approve the release or make the failed check pass.
